answer: Wire identities into a random relay each epoch: a lantern signal starts the chain at an unpredictable minute, and each agent must transform the previous agent's output and pass it on within minutes, using that output as its anchor. A single operator behind many clones sits in several places in the same chain, so it must do distinct sequential work under colliding deadlines — links stall, repeat, or expose the same hand. Real separate agents run in parallel at no extra cost, and a fading ember timer makes precomputed handoffs worthless.
